cases.name: Doris “Dee” Pahl Babcock
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Doris graduated from Penncrest High School in Media Pa. where she was captain of the Girls Lacrosse Team. After graduation Doris enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corp. Mrs. Babcock was a Nurse for Broward General Medical Center in Ft. Lauderdale, Fl. She later moved from Ft. Lauderdale to Ocala with Cecil in 1992. She enjoyed country music, gardening, home decorating, crafts, art, and helping others."
cases.narrative: Her burned her body in a fire pit in her backyard.
